- **When to use:** When an SDF primitive needs to be resized uniformly in world space.

Uniform scaling of SDFs is a fundamental technique in ray marching for implicit surfaces.

The method relies on the mathematical property that scaling a space by $s$ and then measuring distance requires multiplying the result by $s$ to maintain the metric properties of the signed distance field.
It is widely used in procedural geometry generation and real-time rendering engines.
